action_reasoning: Every fact is present and clear. Rules 1 to 4 pass (ischemic, 28%, echo, NYHA III). Rule 5 fails: a stent placed 2026-07-20 is within 3 months of the 2026-10-15 implant. Rules 6 to 9 pass. One rule not met with complete facts, so escalate.
